Show your steps on a home screen card
The Habit School Android app opens the web app as is, and reads your steps from Health Connect to show them right away on your widget and quick settings tile.

Habit School only reads steps, sleep, exercise and body composition (weight, body fat, basal metabolic rate, lean mass, bone mass, body water, height) from Health Connect. It never writes or deletes anything. What it reads fills in today\'s log and your profile, and only the values you save are stored in your account. We never use it for ads or sell it. You can turn permissions off anytime in Health Connect settings.
